Nina (fin): Heads-up: late-night alert for unassigned GPU-hours in asia-northeast-1 ~6.4k hrs (~$11.8k). Link to anomaly graph: https://console.redwood/graphs/untagged-asia-3101234567
PagerBot: ALERT: untagged_gpu=6400 region=asia-northeast-1 window=2026-03-24T01:00Z-2026-03-24T09:00Z export=s3://billing/exports/2026-03-24/asia-ne-untagged-6400.csv
Omar (ml): That was our multi-run ablation for convo-embed. I forgot to set the billing tag in the k8s job template. Sorry everyone.
Nina (fin): Ok please provide run_ids + owner emails so finance can accept a retroactive tag or draft an internal invoice. We prefer tags + charge to ML cost center.
Leah (platform): Platform can absorb up to $5k from the quarterly buffer. Beyond that needs finance approval. Also we should patch the job template to require `cost_center` at submit. I'll create a change request.
Omar (ml): I'll run the search and upload mapping now. SQL we used: SELECT run_id, user_email, gpu_hours, start_time FROM gpu_usage WHERE region='asia-northeast-1' AND cost_center IS NULL AND start_time >= '2026-03-24';
Omar (ml): Mapping uploaded -> s3://ml-logs/2026-03-24/convo-embed-backfill.csv. Starting retro-tag job.
Nina (fin): Proposal: Leah covers $5k. Remaining ~$6.8k billed to ML R&D via INT-2026-03300. Leah, can you approve $5k here?
Leah (platform): Approved: Leah (platform) :white_check_mark:. I'll also open a ticket to add server-side validation on submit.
Nina (fin): I approve charging $6.8k to ML R&D contingent on the backfill artifact being attached to the invoice and run-owner mapping. Audit note required: "retro-tagging asia-ne convo-embed ablation; platform covered $5k; remaining charged to ML R&D."
Omar (ml): Backfill success log: s3://ml-logs/2026-03-24/convo-embed-backfill-complete.log. All runs now have cost_center=ml-rd.
PagerBot: NOTE: internal-transfer pending INT-2026-03300 (platform_cover=5000, ml_charge=6800).
Nina (fin): Creating internal invoice INT-2026-03300 and attaching exports + backfill logs. Accounting will reconcile next cycle. Closing once posted. Thanks for quick turn-around. :wave:
